name: The Strike and the Mountain Restraint
narrative: Kael, overwhelmed by delirium and psychic dissociation, throws an unarmed punch toward Marcus. Marcus's 'Will to Live at All Costs' trait instantly absorbs and counters the blow: Marcus takes the glancing hit to his shoulder, wraps his arms around Kael in a secure bear-hug tackle, and takes him to the padded wool pallet without striking back. Dr. Harlan and Lyra assist in physically restraining Kael until the delirium subsides.

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The scuffle on the floorboards gives way to heavy breathing; Marcus firmly pins Kael's arms in an embrace of defensive restraint until the violent impulse runs out of kinetic energy.

new_decision.decision: Attempted to hit Marcus under psychic compulsion; was promptly grappled, countered, and gently pinned to the wool mat.
new_decision.impact: Exhausted remaining manic delirium against Marcus's unbreakable survival resilience; brought physical containment.

new_decision.decision: Will to Live triggered: Absorbed the glancing blow to the shoulder, wrapped Kael in a defensive clinch, and held him securely until the frenzy ceased.
new_decision.impact: Prevented escalation; defended own life while preserving the attacker.

new_decision.decision: Assisted in immobilizing Kael's legs with folded wool quilts, ensuring no joint damage occurred during the struggle.
